items.name: Artificer
items.scene: A resourceful adult female dwarf inventor in practical medium armor and a leather tool apron, goggles pushed up above braided hair, standing at an arcane workbench. One hand holds a tiny clockwork construct, the other adjusts it with a precision tool. A dramatic black character silhouette rim-lit by turquoise magical sparks and amber forge light; brass gears, subtle mechanical motifs, an ancient workshop behind.
items.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: fantasy class card illustration, vertical portrait 2:3.
Primary request: Create a new ARTIFICER class card matching the two supplied existing class-card references.
Input images: Image 1 and Image 2 are style and layout references only. Match their antique golden rectangular frame with engraved corner filigree, arched interior opening, painterly vivid atmospheric color and strong black full-body character silhouette. Original character and scenery.
Scene: A resourceful adult female dwarf inventor in practical medium armor and a leather tool apron, goggles pushed up above braided hair, standing at an arcane workbench. One hand holds a tiny clockwork construct, the other adjusts it with a precision tool. A dramatic black character silhouette rim-lit by turquoise magical sparks and amber forge light; brass gears, subtle mechanical motifs, an ancient workshop behind.
Composition: central full-body hero, dramatic rim lighting, textured fantasy-book painted illustration, ornate gold frame, cream parchment title plaque integrated at the bottom exactly like the references. Maintain breathing room inside frame; keep whole silhouette and relevant props visible.
Text (verbatim): "ARTIFICER" on the bottom parchment plaque, bold black classical serif capitals, correctly spelled and legible. No other writing.
Constraints: consistent border proportions and title area with references; no extra names, no watermark, no modern technology, no photorealism.

items.name: Psion
items.scene: An adult male elf psychic adept wearing flowing unarmored robes, levitating serenely above fractured stone with one hand near his temple and the other open. A powerful dark silhouette rim-lit by violet and azure psionic energy. Several small stones suspended in precise orbit and translucent geometric waves convey telekinesis and disciplined mental power; atmospheric ruined sanctuary behind. No wizard hat, staff, fireball or spellbook.
